records.claim: Coincidence, symmetry, compactness and balanced subarrays reduce specified gradient errors; excessive segmentation can reduce active area and worsen random matching.

records.claim: For identical MOS sections with horizontal channel current, orientation is the mean of ±1 current directions. Matched arrays require equal signed means; equal nonzero means are allowed.

records.claim: ET=SΔTC describes the net contact-temperature EMF; series sections can add or cancel it depending on electrical traversal. Common-centroid placement alone cannot cancel it.

records.title: Exact distributed-finger model before the one-third limit
records.claim: For constant r,g and a singly terminated finger of length L, Rtotal=RSi·u·coth(u), u=L√(rg); small u gives added metal R≈rL/3.
records.assumptions: Uniform geometry and distributed silicon conductance; v(0)=V, i(L)=0. Not a generic bound for tapered/strongly nonuniform devices. Supplied E.6 sign, E.8 prefactor and E.14 sqrt appear inconsistent.
records.derivation_if_any: Solve v′=−ri and i′=−gv with open far-end boundary: i(0)=√(g/r)V tanh(L√(rg)); invert and use g=1/(LRSi). Expand ucothu=1+u²/3−u⁴/45+…. This agrees with source E.9; correction is audit algebra, not publisher-confirmed erratum.

records.claim: Skin/proximity loss, eddy currents, capacitance and surrounding metal determine frequency-dependent inductor quality; patterned shields must interrupt induced loops.

records.title: Half-space thermal spreading is a derived ideal model
records.claim: For a surface point heater in a homogeneous isotropic semi-infinite body with an otherwise adiabatic surface and fixed far-field temperature, ΔT=P/(2πkr).
records.locator: Fourier-law basis: §8.2.7 Thermal Gradients, Eq.(8.22), printed p.385. The half-space result is derived in the handbook, not printed as this equation in the book.
records.assumptions: Constant k, steady state, hemispherical spreading, ideal point source, no finite die/package/layer effects. Singular near-source field requires finite-source treatment or labeled regularization.
records.derivation_if_any: Conservation on a hemisphere gives heat flux P/(2πr²). Fourier law gives dT/dr=−P/(2πkr²); integrate from r to infinity where T=T∞. Full unbounded space instead has 4π. The transient PDE adds local energy storage to the same flux balance.

records.title: Johnson–Nyquist foundational citation gap
records.claim: The glossary states classical one-sided resistor voltage PSD 4kBTR; no exact supporting equation was located in the supplied corpus.
records.locator: Foundational law with no verified corpus locator
records.assumptions: Equilibrium passive resistor, classical frequency regime, one-sided PSD in V²/Hz. The formula itself is a background assumption in this handbook.
records.derivation_if_any: Conditional consistency check: filtering 4kBTR by 1/[1+(2πfRC)²] and integrating f≥0 gives kBT/C. This integration does not independently prove the underlying thermal-noise law.

records.title: Equilibrium sampled-capacitor noise
records.claim: One ideal equilibrated linear capacitor has voltage variance kBT/C.
records.locator: Independent equipartition derivation; no exact supplied-PDF kT/C passage located
records.assumptions: One thermalized degree of freedom, classical equilibrium, no incomplete settling or correlated-sampling modification; a full DAC has other transfer factors.
records.derivation_if_any: Equipartition gives ½C Var(v)=½kBT, so Var(v)=kBT/C. Foundational equipartition premise is assumed; do not cite the DAC paper as the source of this formula.

records.title: Zero failures do not prove zero failure rate
records.claim: For n independent representative Bernoulli trials with zero failures, a one-sided 1−α upper bound is 1−α^(1/n), approximately −ln(α)/n.
records.assumptions: Independent identically distributed outcomes and a fixed acceptance event; not weighted importance samples or adaptive/censored failures.
records.derivation_if_any: P(no failures|p)=(1−p)^n. Invert at α. At 95% confidence and n=1000 the upper bound is about 0.00299125 (0.2991%).

records.title: Half-LSB single-pole settling

records.assumptions: Single pole; unit full-scale initial error; half-LSB allocation; no slew/ringing or other error consuming the allocation.
records.derivation_if_any: Require exp(−t/τ)≤2^(−N−1), take logs. This is not a sample-rate certificate for an arbitrary switched array.
